entities.summary: Thomen Stauch (b. 1970-03-11, Krefeld) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Krefeld and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
